root_cause: The LinkedIn capability verifier used Composio API v3 tool execution, whose default tool version can resolve to the legacy pinned definition. Production readback returned HTTP 400 for LINKEDIN_GET_MY_INFO.
prevention: Use Composio API v3.1 for LinkedIn tool execution.
Explicitly request version latest for deterministic current-tool execution.
Use structured arguments for read-only LinkedIn capability calls instead of natural-language inference.
Treat provider readback failure as an implementation failure and do not infer capability from dashboard connectivity.
